publication issues.summary: AP393 private partial reconstruction: unchanged baseline converts exit 0 with one unresolved difference, zero wire glyph differences. At [120,84], source AR printed location starts U+FFFD and rendered B uses retained normalized B-E1E4; native B is plausible but damaged and not independently legible enough to verify. Separate AU output U10 versus normalized D10 conflict remains unresolved in sidecar; missing page division remains a format question. No source correction or new physical pin/electrical join inferred. Native overview, selected native tiles, flagged region and all 31 junction/86 crossing panels viewed. 104 routes/159 segments map to 25 overlapping sections, but no complete end-to-end electrical or omission proof is claimed. Box registration 54/56 median 1.42 render pixels; independent edge fit 14/16 median 1.55 with only two right-side controls, nine-point maximum disagreement 10.94 pixels. The sparse right control and global fits do not establish local distortion bounds. Candidate and review unapproved; no canonical source, key or publication changed. Native, source, electrical, full trace and omission claims remain bounded by source review.
publication issues.qualification: Published for access with the recorded review limitations; no electrical correctness or user approval asserted.
